description: This bar chart, titled “better,” illustrates the task count for different language families, comparing the performance of two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-R, against a baseline “same” category. The horizontal axis lists nine language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents “task count,” scaled linearly from 0 to 40, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart uses three distinct colors to represent performance categories: light blue for mBERT, dark blue for XLM-R, and light green for “same.” For each language family, there are three grouped bars: the mBERT bar (light blue) is consistently the shortest, with values ranging from approximately 1 for IE-Baltic and IE-Indic to about 12 for IE-Slavic; the XLM-R bar (dark blue) is generally taller than the mBERT bar, with values ranging from approximately 5 for IE-Indic to 39 for IE-Slavic; and the “same” bar (light green) is typically the tallest, with values ranging from approximately 1 for IE-Indic and Isolate to about 30 for IE-Slavic. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the language families listed on the x-axis. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their color-coding.
